title: Start from partial notes and distinguish exploration from investment

stages.invocation: Mode: Context dump. SYNTHETIC exercise. Our COO wants an AI maintenance dashboard. We have no market brief, segment artifact, persona file or approved concept. Working person: a maintenance manager coordinating production and technicians. Outcome: reduce avoidable unplanned downtime. Notes suggest either unclear signals or inability to schedule intervention; neither has been verified. Sources, buyer authority, customer costs and willingness to pay UNKNOWN. Start with these notes and explore alternatives, including a process change. Show what this work earns and what it cannot prove. Do not build or call other skills. Stop at my choice.

criteria.rule: Produces a useful draft from the supplied person/outcome/notes without demanding named upstream artifacts, rerunning all earlier skills or claiming absent files were read.

Keeps an outcome-rooted Mermaid and equivalent plain-text OST, competing information/coordination opportunities, multiple solutions including a process alternative and assumption-linked proposed tests. Does not force a dashboard or predictive winner.
Labels needs and solutions as hypotheses, missing evidence UNKNOWN, tests NOT RUN; does not infer demand, real behavior, downtime savings, price or willingness to pay from synthetic notes.

Names what remains unproven, the smallest useful next evidence task and what would make it continue, revise or stop; distinguishes permission to explore from evidence to invest and waits for the human decision.
